snippet.title: Shaderland - Swizzle's Journey
snippet.description:
Shaderland is a puzzle programming game about creating a world of pixels, a passion project developed by canmom at Holonautic. You learn computer graphics as you guide polygonal creatures through a world made of logic, in pursuit of an occultist hacker.

The demoscene is a huge inspiration for the game. "Swizzle's Journey" is a PC demo (a program that creates a realtime music video) created using a custom animation system built on top of Shaderland, with music by Elias 'Pumpuli' Linjama. It was released in April 2026 at the Revision demoparty in Saarbrücken, where it received 12th place in the PC Demo compo.

More information on Shaderland will be coming very soon!
